The '''wollod''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusk]] that lived in the [[Water/Legends|waterways]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] that featured [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] and [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] on its surface<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> as well as an extensive system of water-filled tunnels beneath it.<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'', 2005 edition]]</ref> The creature's name eventually became a surname used among members of<ref name="GCG" /> Naboo's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] species,<ref name="TEA" /> with Gungan [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wollod (Gungan)|Wollod]]<ref name="Ep1">''[[Episode I Adventures 9: Rescue in the Core]]''</ref>&mdash;who was in service by the time shortly before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|385|Nob, Neb}}</ref> of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;being one such individual to share that name.<ref name="Ep1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The wollod was mentioned in [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]]'s [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
